questions.question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

There are already many examples of great technology that had born in the United States.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**of great technology that had**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The given sentence is in present tense as indicated by the use of the word "are."**
 
• **Thus, the use of the verb "had" is incorrect.**
 
• The correct verb form to use in this sentence is "has" instead of "had" as the technology still exists.
 
• Also, has will be the perfect verb since, the subject "great technology" is singular.
 
• The correct sentence should be:
 
 
• "There are already many examples of great technology that has been born in the United States."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

__
 
• The original sentence uses the present perfect tense, "They have been dejected."
 
• **However, the past perfect tense is needed because the dejection happened before the arrival of the person mentioned in the sentence.**
 
• **The past perfect tense is formed by using "had" + past participle, so the correct option is "They had been."**
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• They had been dejected when he arrived, but now they sparkle with enthusiasm.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 4 (They were been) is incorrect because "were" is the past tense form of "be" and should not be used with "been."
